title: GEOMORPHOLOGICAL MAP SYMBOLS

lists.name: Forms Due to Volcanicity
items: Slopes of volcanic cones with gradients of 2–4°
Lava bridges or tunnels, spatters cones, driblet cones, lava cascades and tumuli

lists.name: Forms Due to Denudation
items: Remnants of pediments formed by erosion and denudation

lists.name: Constructional Forms Due to Denudation
items: Plains due to proluvial accumulation (playa, sabkha)

lists.name: Destructional Forms Due to River Erosion
Fluvial-denudational Forms
items: Valley sides cut during the Würm glaciations
Sides of structural gaps cut in quartzite
Sides of gaps formed by headward erosion
Break of slopes separating various generations of valleys of differing age
Small valleys produced in cooperation with solifluction
Small valleys produced by periodic water acting in cooperation with denudation

lists.name: Fluvioglacial Forms
items: Valley, channel sides cut by proglacial water during the former glaciations
Sides of glacier margin valley trains (Urstromtal) cut by proglacial and extraglacial water during the former glaciations
Sides of inherited gaps dating from the former glaciations

lists.name: Karst Forms reproduced in insoluble rock-cover
Forms Due to Solution and Water Erosion
items: Steep terminal walls of blind valleys
Flat floors of central poljes covered with gravel
Flat floors of central poljes covered with sand
Flat floors of central poljes covered with silt
Flat floors of central poljes with rocky bottom
Surfaces due to karst planation (see destructional surfaces)
Segments of karst gorges formed by collapse of cavern roof

lists.name: Karst Forms Due to Deposition of Calcium Carbonate
Forms Due to Deposition of Mineral Salts by Heated Underground Water
Glacial Forms
items: Destructional Forms Due to Glacial Erosion
Lateral morainic ridges due to ablation (lateral pseudo-moraine)

lists.name: Constructional Forms Due to Nivation
items: Protalus ramparts, nivation ridges, winter talus ridges

lists.name: Thermokarst
items: Forms Due to Melting Out of Buried Ice Blocks
Channels due to melting out of buried ice masses
Forms Due to Melting Out of Hydrolaccoliths
Ablation troughs surrounded by a mound (post-pingo)

lists.name: Eolian (Aeolian) Forms
items: Destructional Forms Due to Wind Erosion

lists.name: Marine Forms
items: Submarine outer edge of wave-cut platform
Constructional Forms Due to Marine Deposition
Floors of watten (tidal flats, sand, mud)
Alluvial fans at priele (tide channel) mouths
Ridges formed by sand filling up priele
